question: Does the single evidence-triggered ward-before-edge policy control preserve every null identity and affect only the preregistered Afterimage within-fight order mediator, without changing RNG, acquisition, card content, energy costs, Scoreline or Ashwarden?

closedPredecessorBoundary.fightLocalV2Identity: Frozen success. Its combat rules and combat state are byte-identical in this candidate.
closedPredecessorBoundary.fightLocalV2Capacity: Frozen futility. Scoreline and Afterimage current-policy natural-capacity blocks remain closed exactly as recorded.
closedPredecessorBoundary.evidenceTrigger: The zero-row decomposition and immutable topology jointly identify acquisition plus within-fight order as Afterimage's bottleneck and select exactly one current versus ward-before-edge control.
closedPredecessorBoundary.noRescue: This is a distinct representation, schema, probe identity and disjoint cohort. It does not change, rerun or reinterpret any closed row.

scorelinePayoff.definition: Duskblade exact Chisel realised hit sets one target-local non-stacking mark; a later exact Executioner on that living target consumes it for one separate bounded raw damage operation.
scorelinePayoff.lifecycle: Until consume, marked-target death or combat end.
scorelinePayoff.status: Unchanged frozen v2 factor; no new Scoreline capacity or endpoint row is in this experiment.

afterimagePayoff.definition: Duskblade exact Defend realised Ward sets one player-local non-stacking bounded value; a later exact Warden's Edge in the same player turn consumes it for one separate mirrored-Ward operation.

afterimageOrder.definition: A research-only policy decision factor. Current uses the frozen policy unchanged. Ward-before-edge selects exact Defend before current scoring only when every trigger in the order-control contract is true.

frozenCausalFactors.independence: Scoreline payoff, Afterimage payoff and Afterimage order are separate causal factors. This is not the old four-factor design and no acquisition-priority or rarity factor is varied.

orderControlContract.scope: Duskblade deterministic BalancePilot card choice only; research-only and absent from product truth.
orderControlContract.eligibility: Afterimage payoff is non-off; no Afterimage value is stored; exact Defend and exact Warden's Edge are both in hand and individually legal; their exact sequential authored costs fit current energy.
orderControlContract.decision: Return exact Defend before the unchanged current scoring path. Once a value is stored, the control is inactive and current policy selects the later Warden's Edge.
orderControlContract.mediator: Only the already frozen Afterimage Ward value; the control creates no state of its own.
orderControlContract.consumer: The unchanged frozen exact Warden's Edge consumer.
orderControlContract.naturalCosts: Acquisition, draw, hand co-presence, authored costs, current energy, target legality and subsequent current-policy choice remain real. No card, energy, draw or acquisition is granted.
orderControlContract.rng: No RNG call, seed change or cohort-dependent branch.
orderControlContract.telemetry: One research421AfterimageOrder intervention event only after the selected Defend successfully plays; producer, mediator, consumer and payoff telemetry remain the frozen direct events.
orderControlContract.nullPath: Omitted settings, explicit both-payoffs-off/current, current level, Ashwarden, missing either exact card, insufficient sequential energy or an already-stored value do not intervene.
orderControlContract.factorIsolation: The control reads only Afterimage enablement and combat state; Scoreline settings cannot change the decision.
orderControlContract.expiry: No new lifecycle. The frozen Afterimage mediator expires on consume or player-turn end.
orderControlContract.excluded: No generic hold policy, optimiser, ML, RL, scoring-weight change, content change, save field, relic, ChoiceScreen, acquisition change, random play change or online adaptation.

afterimageOrder.constraint: ward-before-edge is illegal when Afterimage payoff is off

encodingGrammar.rejection: Unknown schema type/value, unknown key, unknown token, enabled order with Afterimage off, or non-dictionary settings terminates before RunState construction.

design.type: single-factor identity preflight with common random numbers and mechanism-blocked direct controls; not a factorial and not an endpoint experiment
nullMatrix: candidate with both payoffs off and order=current
directMatrix: eligible Dusk, energy two, both exact cards: current versus ward-before-edge
eligible Dusk shared Scoreline-on anchor: current versus ward-before-edge

anchors.eligible: Proves current chooses Warden's Edge while enabled chooses Defend then current policy consumes with Warden's Edge.
anchors.null: Pristine, omitted and explicit null share all 265 identities.
anchors.interference: The single Scoreline-on direct anchor must exactly equal the matching Scoreline-off direct path and emit no Scoreline event.

mechanisticallyJustifiedInteractions: Afterimage payoff availability by Afterimage order is structural legality, not an estimated interaction.
Scoreline payoff by Afterimage order is checked only at one shared direct interference anchor.
design.aliasStructure: Omitted settings aliases both payoffs off and current order. Explicit current is the exact policy null. Ward-before-edge has no legal off-payoff alias. The direct Scoreline anchor aliases its corresponding Scoreline-off path only if measured interference is exactly zero.
design.omittedCells: No enabled whole-run, acquisition, rarity, payoff-level sweep, joint Cartesian product, causal endpoint, ML, RL, optimiser, protected seed, persistent fallback or product cell is authorised.

cohort.disjointness: Root 554 and every listed seed are absent from closed v1, v2 identity and v2 capacity cohorts.

estimands.pristineIdentity: Zero canonical row mismatches after removing only the candidate probe research-state observation for pristine versus omitted across 265 paired identities.
estimands.explicitNullIdentity: Zero canonical row mismatches after the same removal for omitted versus explicit off/current across 265 paired identities.
estimands.rngIdentity: Zero final RNG mismatches across all three null arms and every current/enabled direct pair.
estimands.interfaceSafety: All eight malformed or illegal settings fail for the preregistered reason without output.
estimands.sourceCardinality: Exactly one deterministic order-helper call and one intervention telemetry append site.
estimands.eligibleMediatorEffect: Current chooses only Warden's Edge; enabled chooses exact Defend then Warden's Edge and emits exact producer, mediator-set, consumer, mediator-consume, payoff and one intervention event with realised payoff five.
estimands.ineligibleNulls: Energy-one, missing-Defend, missing-Warden's-Edge, Ash and occupied-mediator pairs are exact row identities with zero intervention events.
estimands.interference: The Scoreline-on anchor is exact against the corresponding Scoreline-off current and enabled paths and emits zero Scoreline events.
estimands.precision: All estimands are exact Boolean/count gates with required fault or mismatch count zero; no fit, interval or stochastic effect estimate is used.
estimands.notEstimated: Natural capacity, acquisition support, endpoint effect, policy repertoire viability, detector acceptance, candidate feasibility, product balance or protected confirmation.

executionAndStopping.construction: Deterministic Python owns the fixed null cohort, seven paired direct cells, validation, content-addressed plans and outputs, exact comparison and stop/go.
order: Verify every frozen predecessor, repository ref, source head, file hash, Godot identity and ledger.
Check the order-helper and telemetry call cardinality.
Reject all eight malformed or illegal settings.
Execute the complete pristine null plan once.
Execute the complete candidate omitted-null, explicit-null and fourteen-row direct plan once.
Analyse the sole complete look and verify byte-identical ledger state.
executionAndStopping.firstLook: The complete 809-observation design is the only look. No fault may change a row, trigger, token, cohort, threshold or order under this protocol.
executionAndStopping.stagedConstraint: This stage can establish source, null and direct mediator identity only. It contains no comparably evaluated whole-run enabled endpoint and cannot support a causal endpoint claim.

decisionRules.success: All immutable, predecessor, interface, source-cardinality, exact-null, RNG, eligible-mediator, ineligible-null and Scoreline-interference gates pass; exactly 809 observations complete within 180 seconds and the ledger adds zero rows.
decisionRules.successAuthority: Apply boundary 1: freeze this single order representation and separately preregister the cheapest Afterimage natural-capacity comparison. Do not admit a package, add a factorial or use protected seeds.
decisionRules.futility: Any completed immutable, interface, cardinality, null, RNG, direct-mediator, ineligible-null, interference, row-count or ledger gate fails.
decisionRules.futilityAuthority: Apply boundary 2: close this exact order representation without a rescue loop and continue with the next evidence-backed mechanism inside #421.
decisionRules.inconclusive: A frozen input or fixed process is unavailable, output is incomplete, or the exact decision is unavailable by 180 seconds.
decisionRules.inconclusiveAuthority: Apply boundary 3: record at cap; do not rerun, alter the cohort, repair, infer an endpoint or use protected seeds.
